sources.title: 朱翌《猗覺寮雜記》四庫系卷下小運段
sources.quality_notes: Lines 409–411 distinguish calendar/gan-zhi and Xiaoyun; fixed start pairs confirmed in 15CJ already registered received routes, this separate Siku digital access not an independent physical witness. No annual step or boundary explicitly stated in Zhu's paragraph.

sources.title: 《五行精紀》卷三十三末〈論小運〉受讀
sources.quality_notes: Lines 2101–2105 attribute fixed rule to Zhushenjing and Sanming Tiyao; age one, male forward/female reverse and return at 61. Distinct year-dun passage gives Jiazi example. Earlier cited book attribution and exact physical text are not independently verified; ctext registered V33 route returned 403 at this check.

sources.title: 謝采伯《宻齋筆記》卷五：天德貴人及兩四柱例
sources.quality_notes: Two cases 丙寅/丙申 戊戌 辛酉 戊子 (normalize 戍 to 戌 for computational replay only), year branch differs. Tiande partial 寅丁 卯申 and Guiren 甲戊庚丑未. No day-master full algorithm or independent outcomes.

sources.title: 《密齋筆記》卷五識典原文入口
sources.quality_notes: Lines 12–15 corroborate four pairs and partial mappings, 戌/戍 variation and OCR corruption. No original glyph adjudication; same work not a second historical vote.

sources.title: 《密齋筆記》四庫提要：永樂大典輯佚
sources.quality_notes: Preface explicitly reports original lost and scattered Yongle Dadian text recompiled into five juan plus one sequel, dated Qianlong 46 ninth month. Not original Song folio or proof that every phrase was present in Song original.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Common fixed Xiaoyun starts do not prove direct copying between Zhu, Wuxing Jingji and Sanming HuiTong
Two case replays do not prove full historical day-master method or actual predictive accuracy
Qing reconstructed received text is not an independently dated Song folio
unresolved_lineage_questions: Independent early leaves and quoted Zhushenjing/Sanming Tiyao original identity; fixed versus year-dun Xiaoyun scope and annual boundary
Mizhai Yongle Dadian original leaf and edition lineage; case person/date binding and complete shensha rules
